commit_scope: The API suite is a proof a pull request carries again: tests stop reading the routes the native host owns (health, ready, ideas lists and single reads, graph node reads, workspace vitality) and keep this host's own claims; the Test workflow runs the suite on pull requests that touch the API or the kernel and the web build when the web changes; the companion-apk workflow loses a step that called a kernel script released in September; the arrival documents say which proof a PR carries.
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-21 07:55 WITA: .github/workflows/test.yml has carried `if: false` since 2026-03-23 and no other workflow runs pytest, so pull requests merged (and deployed) with no API suite in CI; the suite run locally on main (cd api && pytest -q --ignore=tests/holdout) read 18 failed, 397 passed in 41 s, every failure a read of a route #4117 moved to the native container: /api/health and /api/ready (404), GET /api/ideas and /api/ideas/{id} (405), /api/graph/nodes/{id} (405), /api/workspaces/{id}/vitality (404).

Released rather than healed toward the retired owner: test_health_returns_ok_with_schema_ok, the CLI contract shapes for /api/ideas and /api/health and the CLI ideas smoke, test_ideas_list_honors_accept_language_header, the two graph-node identity/slug tests, test_vitality_returns_six_signals, test_health_shows_smart_reap_available; the mixed flows (core API health/meta, idea crud/lifecycle/fork, multi-device identity, project delete, workspace tenancy, vitality-and-meeting, grocery generic reads) keep this host's writes and Python-owned reads and say in place that the read is the native host's. api/config/native_api.json is the ownership source each comment names.
After the release: 406 passed, 0 failed in 45.6 s (the first full run); the run after the index change in this push is the one named in the companion record.

Test workflow: pull_request with path filters (api/**, form, Dockerfile.api, scripts/fkwu_run.sh, the workflow itself, web/**) plus workflow_dispatch; the API job builds the kernel seed (cc -O2 -o fkwu runtime/fkwu-uni.c) because the suite stages recipes on it, installs the API, runs the commit-evidence and spec-quality validators over the PR range, validate_workflow_references.py, and `pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --ignore=tests/holdout`; the web job builds and tests only when web/ changed; dependabot PRs are skipped. Not on push to main: a merge deploys, the proof belongs before it.

validate_workflow_references.py reported one missing reference: sema-companion-apk.yml step 'Native form-cli (kernel in the pocket)' called form/form/build-android-form-cli.sh, released from the kernel on 2026-09-10 (edd8e77b2), under `set +e` so it could only ever print 'skipped'; the step is removed; the validator reads 0 missing.

docs/shared/agent-start-packet.md (Validation), AGENTS.md (Commands, Other Conventions) and CLAUDE.md (Validation) now say: a PR touching api/, the form gitlink or the image recipe carries the API suite in CI, holdout stays out, routes the native host owns are proven by the native observations.
